instrument: Sunflower Redevelopment District, TIF Redevelopment Project Plan 3 (Digital Astra Park North, LLC)
summary: Two data center buildings of about 1,425,000 sq ft on 273.88 acres, total project cost $7,522,879,333. Developer projects about $358.7 million of TIF revenue over the statutory maximum 20 years from incremental ad valorem property tax only; 80% of increment reimburses developer costs on a pay-as-you-go basis, the balance to the city for district infrastructure; the city does not pledge its credit. Developer may also seek an IRB sales-tax exemption on construction materials.

source.citation: City of De Soto Planning Commission packet, Sept 22, 2026, Item 7c (TIF Project Plan) and City Attorney memo Sept 17, 2026

notes: District based on a 'blighted area' finding (Ordinance 2527, Jan 20, 2022; expanded Ord. 2598, Dec 7, 2023) under K.S.A. 12-1770 et seq. Process: Planning Commission conformance finding, then City Council resolution and public hearing (dates TBD — forward calendar). Resolves 3M vs 1.5M sq ft: plan states ~1.425M in two buildings. Construction 2027-2030.
confidence_note: TIF plan and memo read in full. Which item the reported 5-2 PC vote applied to is unconfirmed; site plan staff report (Item 7b) is a scanned image not yet read.
